name: KLOE / KLOE-2
summary: KLOE / KLOE-2 operated at DAΦNE, INFN Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati. Successive upgrades at the same facility are grouped in one record; dark-sector searches form part of a multipurpose physics program.
detection_principle: At the ϕ factory, radiative return in e⁺e⁻ collisions produces U bosons sought as e⁺e⁻, μ⁺μ⁻ or π⁺π⁻ mass peaks; dark-Higgsstrahlung may yield lepton pairs plus missing energy.

key_parameters.name: Collision-energy region
key_parameters.value: Near the ϕ resonance, approximately 1.02 GeV

results.summary: No signal in dark-Higgsstrahlung with μ⁺μ⁻ plus missing final states.
No U signal in π⁺π⁻; complementary limits were obtained at masses of 527–987 MeV.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
